WITH RECURSIVE
current_inventory AS (
    SELECT id, set_num
    FROM (
        SELECT
            id,
            set_num,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY set_num
                ORDER BY version DESC, id DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM inventories
    ) AS t
    WHERE rn = 1
),
children AS (
    SELECT inventory_id, set_num AS child_num, quantity
    FROM inventory_sets
    UNION ALL
    SELECT inventory_id, fig_num AS child_num, quantity
    FROM inventory_minifigs
),
path AS (
    SELECT ci.id AS inventory_id, 1::BIGINT AS multiplier
    FROM current_inventory AS ci
    WHERE ci.set_num = '80033-1'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT child_ci.id AS inventory_id,
           p.multiplier * COALESCE(ch.quantity, 0)::BIGINT AS multiplier
    FROM path AS p
    JOIN children AS ch
      ON ch.inventory_id = p.inventory_id
    JOIN current_inventory AS child_ci
      ON child_ci.set_num = ch.child_num
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(ip.quantity, 0)::BIGINT * p.multiplier), 0)
FROM path AS p
JOIN inventory_parts AS ip
  ON ip.inventory_id = p.inventory_id
WHERE ip.part_num = '15504'
  AND COALESCE(ip.is_spare, FALSE) = FALSE;
```

),
target_sets AS (
    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    WHERE s.year = 2013
      AND s.theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM theme)
),
set_current_inv AS (
    SELECT set_num, inv_id
    FROM (
        SELECT
            i.set_num,
            i.id AS inv_id,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY i.set_num
                ORDER BY i.version DESC, i.id DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM inventories i
        JOIN sets s ON s.set_num = i.set_num
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
set_paths AS (
    SELECT ts.set_num AS root_set, ts.set_num AS set_num, 1 AS multiplier
    FROM target_sets ts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sp.root_set, ns.set_num, sp.multiplier * ns.quantity
    FROM set_paths sp
    JOIN set_current_inv sci ON sci.set_num = sp.set_num
    JOIN inventory_sets ns ON ns.inventory_id = sci.inv_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(sp.multiplier * im.quantity AS BIGINT)), 0) AS total_minifigs
FROM set_paths sp
JOIN set_current_inv sci ON sci.set_num = sp.set_num
JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = sci.inv_id
JOIN minifigs m ON m.fig_num = im.fig_num;
```

    FROM themes
    WHERE name = 'Collectible Minifigures'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.id
    FROM themes AS t
    JOIN theme_sub AS ts ON t.parent_id = ts.id
),
theme_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT id
    FROM theme_sub
),
target_sets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.set_num
    FROM sets AS s
    JOIN theme_ids AS t ON s.theme_id = t.id
    WHERE s.year = 2024
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.qty), 0)
FROM u_explosion AS e
JOIN target_sets AS ts ON e.root_num = ts.set_num
WHERE e.root_kind = 'set'
  AND e.is_current = TRUE
  AND e.item_kind = 'minifig';
